subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: give me a few grains of corns i am dying of hunger said the grasshopper but what did you do in summer didnt you store up any corn asked the ant no i was too busy replied the grasshopper Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "Give me a few grains of corns. I am dying of hunger," said the Grasshopper. "But what did you do in the summer? Didn't you store up any corn?" the Ant asked. "No, I was too busy," replied the Grasshopper. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
